title: FACE: A Fine-grained Reference Free Evaluator for Conversational Recommender Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the Pearson correlation between the average word count of system responses and the overall evaluation scores, then comparing these correlations to those derived from human judgments to check for unjustified preference for longer outputs.

Assessing whether the LLM-based evaluator prefers system-generated responses over human-generated responses at a rate significantly different from human annotators by evaluating pairs of system and human responses.
